description: Three-Phase Power Flow Dataset for the Brazilian PAI14 Distribution Feeder (Araraquara) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Cristhian Oliveira (University of Sao Paulo). Repository Description This document describes the columns and data structure of each file used to model the real Brazilian distribution feeder analyzed in the associated research article. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
